scope: P6 notification preferences, runtime consumers, profile-update recipient filtering, and verified-email delivery foundation

checks.name: go_services_runtime
checks.detail: Windows Application Control blocked the newly linked test executable after compilation

implemented: Versioned server-validated account preferences for desktop notification, taskbar attention, unread badge, reaction selection, sound choices, friend activity choices, and optional email categories.
OS notification display, Electron taskbar flash, taskbar/title/favicon unread badge, message sound pack, and focused-channel sound consume the saved preferences.
Profile updates require both the actor share preference and each recipient profile-update preference.
Durable verified-address email jobs support category consent, claiming, bounded retry/backoff, terminal cancellation, and confirmed delivery.
Security and account-protection email interfaces remain outside optional category consent.
open_acceptance: Independent installed-Windows and browser permission/notification acceptance.
Real incoming-call ringtone lifecycle and sound preview.
Event producers for stream, online-friend, anniversary, and category email events.
Email delivery-time consent recheck, deduplication keys, and unsubscribe-link endpoint.
Server event CRUD, RSVP, and scheduling.
